items.title: 4.9 Importance of stoichiometry in production and dosage of medicine (dawa banane aur dose mein stoichiometry ki ahmiyat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.9, printed page 91, with a self-check.

blocks.text: Dawa ki required dose (zaroori miqdar) tayyar karte waqt dawa mein active ingredient (dawa ka asal kaam karne wala hissa) ki optimum (bilkul theek) amount zaroori hai, taake mareez par desired effect (chahiya hua asar) ho. Stoichiometry dawa banane (drug synthesis) mein accuracy (durusti) pakki karti hai. Zara si ghalti se reaction adhoora reh sakta hai, ya dawa mein bina react kiye reactants ya by-products ka contamination (milawat) ho sakta hai. Stoichiometry ki madad se chemists reactions ko theek theek control kar ke dawaein banate hain, aur un ki efficiency, effectiveness (asar) aur safe use pakka karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek tablet banate waqt ek reactant equation ki zaroorat se thora kam dala gaya. Is chapter ki roshni mein batayein ke dawa mein kya kharabi ho sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: Woh reactant limiting ban jayega, to active ingredient zaroorat se kam banega aur dose kam hogi. Doosra reactant excess mein bach kar dawa mein contamination (milawat) karega, jo nuqsan-deh ho sakta hai. Sahi stoichiometric amounts se hi pure aur sahi dose milti hai.

items: Sahi dose ke liye active ingredient ki optimum amount zaroori hai; stoichiometry dawa banane ko accurate rakhti hai aur adhoore reaction ya contamination se bachati hai.
